Subject: Quick follow-up from today's discovery / propose technical deep dive

Hi Jamie / Olivia —

Thanks again for the conversation this morning — really helpful to understand FinPath's ingestion patterns and how you route PII. Quick recap and next steps: 

- Recap: primary use case is real-time summarization for agent chat + nightly embedding refresh for search.
- Success metric: reduce avg latency for live chat to <250ms 95th percentile and cut per-token inference cost by ~40% compared to current baseline.
- Open questions we flagged: data residency for EU customers, audit log retention, and procurement timelines.

Next step: we'd like to schedule a 60-minute technical deep dive / demo where we can show the runtime, discuss integration patterns, and explicitly cover security requirements. Proposed slots (PT):
- Wed 2026-02-18, 10:00–11:00
- Thu 2026-02-19, 14:00–15:00

If those don't work, tell me two windows that do and I'll send a calendar invite. Would you also loop in your security and procurement leads so we can address the compliance items in one meeting?

Attached: discovery-notes.pdf (short notes from today's call).

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
(415) 555-8123

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the recap and for the proposed slots. Both look promising. Before we lock a time, two notes:

1) I've looped in our security lead, Lena Park (lena.park@finpath.com), and procurement lead, Mark Rivera (mark.rivera@finpath.com) — they asked to be included so we can confirm data residency + contracting timelines.

2) Can you share a short agenda for the technical deep dive (high-level bullets)? Lena specifically wants to make sure we discuss audit logs, access controls, and encryption-at-rest/key management. Procurement will want a sense of contractual milestones & pricing banding.

We have two preferred windows on our side (ET):
- Wed 2026-02-18, 13:00–14:00 ET (that maps to your 10:00–11:00 PT) — best
- Thu 2026-02-19, 17:00–18:00 ET (maps to your 14:00–15:00 PT) — OK if needed

If you can do the first, Lena and Mark will join.

Thanks — looking forward to the demo.
